rationale: Quinbrook and Rowan identify Rowan Digital Infrastructure as the manager-level company and Cinco as a subordinate Texas campus/SPV. Texas and county records confirm Rowan Cinco LLC as asset owner and borrower, while customer, operator, utility, contractor and lender roles are non-equity. The standalone Cinco record should merge into Rowan, but UPP's post-April-2026 platform ownership remains unresolved.
recommendedChanges: Merge/remove the standalone Rowan Cinco PortCo record into Rowan Digital Infrastructure.
Preserve Cinco, Project Cinco, Cinco 1, Rowan Cinco LLC and Rowan Land Resources LLC as subordinate project/SPV identities.
Preserve the Medina County location, 440 acres, 300 MW, construction status and 2027 target.
Exclude Design LLC, Google, AEP Texas, Turner, Medina County, Toronto Dominion and other lenders from equity ownership.
Resolve UPP's post-recapitalization Rowan position before applying the merge or changing Rowan ownership.
unresolvedQuestions: UPP's ownership status after the April 9, 2026 Blackstone recapitalization remains unresolved.
Rowan Cinco LLC's immediate member and intermediate parent are not publicly disclosed.
The exact Rowan owner percentages and recap sellers are not publicly disclosed.
Initial energization was not confirmed by the cutoff and the campus should remain under construction.
fieldCorrections: Do not mark UPP definitively active after the Blackstone recap without explicit later evidence.
Do not treat Quinbrook's old 2022 metadata as a separate Cinco acquisition.
